MAPLE STREET COMMUNITY HALL

Spring Cleanup Day

Saturday, April 18, from 9 in the morning until noon. Volunteers will sweep the hall, wash the windows, and clear the garden beds

behind the building.

Please bring gloves and a bucket if you have them. Coffee, tea, and biscuits will

be served in the kitchen at eleven.

Everyone is welcome. Children may help in

the garden if an adult stays with them.

To sign up, write your name on the sheet by the front door, or call the hall office at 555-0142 before Thursday evening.
